project.name: JukeBox101
project.purpose: Single-instance Discord music submission and Owner review Bot on PostgreSQL

commands.notes: Python is constrained to 3.12. No standalone linter/typecheck is configured in pyproject.toml. Tests must run as non-root; Docker test.Dockerfile provides UID 10002.

external_integrations: Fixed local Docker socket via host worker
Fixed GitHub notification Issue #7; subscribers choose their own GitHub/Email delivery

patterns: Stop old Gateway and confirm exit before starting candidate or rollback
Atomic fsync journal and numeric run/attempt idempotency
Fixed root-owned configuration with default-deny deployment gates
Notification job uses trusted default-branch code only; validates completed runs and appends one fixed-issue comment per run/attempt
Quick CD smoke reuses offline tests and the existing Compose lab; only a local Unix Docker endpoint and synthetic health are admitted
Automatic PR/main CI runs only the isolated smoke entrypoint; Release/Deploy are inert workflow_dispatch placeholders; Notify watches only CI
error_handling: Boundary failures use safe categories without captured credential-bearing output
tests: pytest offline with no network; opt-in disposable postgres tests
Focused policy tests use fake CLI and Docker boundaries; these do not prove real signature/daemon acceptance
Quick smoke includes existing DB driver/cursor contract tests; report real_connection=not_run and real_persistence=not_verified even when the isolated simulation passes

protected_areas.reason: Production schema and stored snapshot compatibility
invariants: CD never applies or restores database migrations
Host pins every schema blob; new migrations require review

protected_areas.reason: Controls live Gateway lifecycle and secret-bearing container
invariants: Formal exchange and claim remain off
Do not alter Office, DNS, firewall, database containers, or credentials

protected_areas.reason: Separates safe automatic tests from deferred live publishing/deployment
invariants: PR/main must not execute migrations, runtime export, GHCR push, SSH or production secrets
Release/Deploy have no automatic trigger or live capability

minimum_after_change: consumer regression checks for shared changes
final diff and git status review
manual_checks: Inspect production bootstrap compatibility and Gateway inventory before enabling host gates
Verify real GHCR provenance and isolated Docker deployment/rollback before enabling CD

known_unknowns: Production SSH account currently cannot operate Docker
Actual production configuration, database target and compatible last-known-good image require current inventory
GitHub environment configuration and branch protections require repository administrator permissions
Each maintainer must subscribe to Issue #7 and enable their own verified email; notification delivery cannot be configured for another account

evidence.fact: Single Gateway entrypoint and shutdown health invalidation
No data migrations in CD; reviewed schema blob set
Shared notifications validate actual deploy job and never gate the CD workflow
Short isolated deployment simulation with truthful failure evidence, no database or remote Docker
Mock DB parameter-forwarding proof is separate from unverified live connection and persistence
Safe-only automatic CI and inert formal workflows replace the old main-push publishing chain
